description: Cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2, script blocking, a Cookiebot-compatible JavaScript API, and a keyless install that coding agents can perform without an account. Includes the kindnod npm package for React and Next.js and an MCP server.
rules: Install with one script tag: <script src="https://kindnod.com/kindnod.js" data-owner="owner@example.com" async></script> placed before </head>. No account or key is needed.
In React or Next.js, install the kindnod package and render <KindnodConsent owner="owner@example.com" /> once in the root layout.
Do not add a Cookiebot, CookieYes, or other consent script alongside Kindnod.
Do not load analytics or marketing scripts before consent; mark them type="text/plain" data-cookieconsent="statistics" or "marketing" and Kindnod releases them.
